answer: Admission runs through a public forge: each new agent must complete a randomly assigned verifiable task before it can transact. Passing earns a non-transferable jade seal unlocking higher-value work; seals decay when idle, so a bought seal soon dies. A yarrow audit lets any peer trigger a random re-check of a sealed agent's past work: fraud shatters the seal and slashes its earnings, honest agents pass untouched. A sybil must pay the forge trial's real work for every clone and keep each jade seal alive under constant yarrow audits — cost grows per copy while each copy's payoff stays small.
